output.reason: The only evidence is a bare commit title, "fix: Only port-forward to ready pods" [ev-c17a311dcffd]. It doesn't say which component does the port-forwarding, what happened before, or whether operators notice any difference. The proposed statement that pods were "previously reachable but non-ready" and "will no longer be established" goes beyond what the title says. It is just as possible that the fix only stops attempts that used to fail, which would make it closer to "none". Deciding between behavior-change and none, and setting a severity, needs the PR or issue text (#10610 / #22794) or an upgrade-guide entry.
